notFound.title: No road leads here
notFound.body: This page isn't on any map we've drawn. Head back and start a new route from the atlas.

expired.title: This map has expired
expired.body: Shared routes stay live for {days} days after their last visit, and this one's trail has gone cold. You can always draw a new one.

notOnDevice.title: Not on this device
notOnDevice.body: Local maps live in this browser only. If you saved it somewhere else, open it from there, or start a new one here.

offline.title: Out of signal
offline.body: This page wasn't saved before the connection dropped. Maps you have already opened on this device still work offline.

global.title: We lost the trail for a moment.
global.body: Something went wrong on our side. Your maps are safe — try picking up where you left off.

Chat.destinationPlaceholder: Austria, the Dalmatian coast, Kyoto and around…

Chat.askDays: How many days do you have, from 2 to 30?
Chat.rateLimited: The atlas needs a breather. Too many drafts in a short while; give it a minute and try again.
Chat.failed: That route didn't come together. Try once more, or start from a blank page.

redraft.hint: Replaces your stops in one step; undo brings them back.

redraft.failed: That redraft didn't come together. Your route is untouched; try again.

Editor.previewEmpty: Add a stop to see it appear on the map.

Units.title: Units & currency
Units.description: Changes how routes read to you only. Budgets are estimated in US dollars and converted at today's rates.
Units.ratesUnavailable: Live rates are out of reach right now, so amounts show in US dollars.

Upsell.title: {max} stops, for now
Upsell.description: Guest maps travel light — {max} cities and a {days}-day link. Sign up (coming soon) for a longer itinerary and a few more keepsakes.

Share.title: Your map is live

Share.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select and copy the link manually.

Contact.title: Contact
Contact.inbox: One inbox for feedback, privacy requests and map reports.
Contact.operator: Grand Tour is run by {operator}, an individual based in {country}. We usually reply within a few working days.

write.title: What to write about
write.feedback: Feedback and bugs. What you tried, what happened, and the page or map link if there is one.
write.report: Report a map. Use “Report this map” on the map itself, or send its link and what’s wrong with it.
write.privacy: Privacy requests. Access, correction or deletion of your data, including removing a map you shared (send its link). See the Privacy notice.

grievance.title: Grievance Officer
grievance.body: {operator}, {country} · {email}. Complaints are acknowledged within {hours} hours and resolved within {days} days.

faq.title: Before you write
faq.lost: Lost a map? Unshared maps live only in the browser where you made them, so we can’t restore them.
faq.expired: Link stopped working? Shared maps expire {days} days after their last view. Share the map again from My Maps for a fresh link.
faq.stops: Need more than {max} stops? Longer itineraries are coming with sign-up; for now, split a long journey into two maps.

About.title: Every journey deserves a map worth sharing
About.lede: Grand Tour turns a trip idea into an interactive route map: cities, nights, trains and flights, drawn by AI or by hand. Free, and no account needed.

start.title: Your next grand tour starts here
start.body: Up to {max} stops, one link, no account.

how.title: From a hunch to a shared map in minutes

describe.title: Describe
describe.body: Tell the AI planner where, how long and what pace, or add cities by hand.

shape.title: Shape
shape.body: Reorder stops, pick trains, flights or drives, and set nights in each place.

share.title: Share
share.body: Send one link to your travel companions, or save the route as a poster.

free.a: Yes. Guest maps are free, with up to {max} stops each.

account.a: No. Your maps are saved in this browser. Sharing creates a link anyone can open, no sign-up needed.

links.q: How long do shared links last?
links.a: A shared map stays live for {days} days after its last view, so links in active use keep working.

ai.a: No. It drafts a sensible route, but check transport, prices, visas and opening hours before you book.

data.a: Unshared maps never leave your browser. See the <link>Privacy notice</link> for what shared maps and the AI planner send to us.
